pins.head: DRAW THE LINES WITH RUGS
pins.sub: Sleep, Sit and Work in One Space
pins.title: Studio Apartment Layout: Give Sleeping, Sitting and Working Their Own Zones
pins.desc: A studio feels chaotic when the bed, the sofa and the desk all share one undefined floor. Decide where each activity lives before you buy anything, then let a rug, a screen or the back of a sofa draw the line. The furniture you already own usually does the dividing. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLiving #RoomDivider
pins.alt: A studio apartment with a teal sofa on a round jute rug in the middle of the floor, the corner of a bed with a terracotta duvet at one side and plants along a wall of windows.

pins.head: KEEP THE JAR, SWAP THE REST
pins.sub: Refill the Jar You Already Like
pins.title: Moisturizer Refills: Keep the Jar and Replace Only the Cream
pins.desc: The glass jar is the part you paid for and the part that lasts. If the line you use sells a refill pouch, the price per ounce usually drops and the jar stays on the counter instead of in the bin. Wash and dry it fully before you decant. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRoutine #RefillNotLandfill #MoisturizerTips
pins.alt: An open glass jar of white cream with its lid beside it and a large plain refill pouch standing on a white bathroom counter, with folded towels behind.

pins.head: SLIDE IT BESIDE THE VANITY
pins.sub: Use the Space Beside the Vanity
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage: A Slim Rolling Cart for the Gap Beside the Vanity
pins.desc: The narrow strip between the vanity and the wall is usually dead space. A slim rolling cart turns it into three shelves you can pull out, and it leaves the tile and the paint untouched. Measure the gap at its narrowest point, not at the doorway. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBathroom #NoDrillStorage #RentalFriendly
pins.alt: A wooden vanity with a sink and soap bottles beside a slim white rolling cart and a tall woven basket on the floor of a small bathroom.

pins.head: READ THE ROLL BEFORE YOU CUT
pins.title: Permanent vs Removable Vinyl: Tell Them Apart Before You Cut
pins.desc: Both rolls feel the same in the hand and neither says anything useful once the sleeve is gone. Keep the label, or write the type on the core the day it arrives. Permanent belongs on mugs and tumblers; removable belongs on walls and windows you want back. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutTips #CraftOrganization
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl, one terracotta and one cream, lying on a pale wooden craft table beside a weeding hook and a cut leaf decal.

pins.head: KEEP SPARE STICKS LOADED
pins.title: All-Temperature Mini Glue Sticks for a Craft Station That Never Stalls
pins.desc: Running out mid-bead is the most annoying way to stop a project, and the gun still has to cool before you can put it away. A long box of all-temperature mini sticks fits the gun you already own and keeps a handful within reach of the stand. Contains affiliate links. #HotGlue #CraftSupplies #DIYProjects
pins.alt: A cream hot glue gun resting on a wooden stand beside a white squeeze bottle of craft glue, a roll of tape and a small terracotta pot on a wooden workbench.

pins.head: THE DESK NEEDS ITS EDGE BACK
pins.sub: Keep One Strip of Desk Empty
pins.title: Small Home Office: Keep the Front Edge of the Desk Clear
pins.desc: A small desk works when one strip stays empty. Push the lamp and the plant to the far corner, put the paper into a sorter and the pens into a shallow tray, and leave the front edge for whatever you are actually doing. It is the cheapest change you can make. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskSetup #SmallSpaceOffice
pins.alt: A wood desk under a bright window with a laptop raised on a stand, a notebook and a mug, a teal armchair pulled up to it and a basket underneath.

pins.head: GREY FIRST, COLOR AFTER
pins.sub: Prime Before You Pick a Palette
pins.title: Miniature Painting: Prime in Grey Before You Choose Any Colour
pins.desc: Bare plastic and resin reject thin paint, and the detail disappears under the second coat you add to fix it. A light grey primer gives the brush something to grip and shows you where the detail actually is. Let it dry fully before the first colour goes on. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #Priming #AcrylicPainting
pins.alt: Two grey primed miniature figures standing on numbered corks beside a plain grey spray can, a cup of brushes and a wet palette on a green cutting mat.

pins.head: CHECK THE CLEARANCE FIRST
pins.sub: A Box That Fits Under the Frame
pins.title: Small Bedroom Storage: Measure the Gap Under the Bed Before You Buy
pins.desc: Under-bed boxes are sold in one height and beds are not. Measure from the floor to the underside of the frame, take an inch off for carpet and castors, and shop to that number. A box an inch too tall is a box that lives in the hall. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #UnderBedStorage #BedroomOrganization
pins.alt: A clear storage box pulled halfway out from under a bed with a teal duvet, with a bedside table and lamp on one side and a clothes rail on the other.

pins.head: WRITE DOWN WHAT YOU TAKE
pins.title: Supplement Labels: Keep a Written List of What You Actually Take
pins.desc: Three bottles on the counter is already more than most people can recall accurately a month later. Copy the name, the serving size and the amount per serving onto one page, and the next comparison takes a minute instead of an evening. Bring the page when someone asks. Contains affiliate links. #SupplementFacts #LabelReading #HealthyHabits
pins.alt: Three amber glass supplement bottles with gold lids standing on a light wooden counter beside an open notepad with its top page curling back.

pins.head: A STAND HOLDS WHAT HOOKS CAN'T
pins.sub: Coats, Bags and a Place to Drop Them
pins.title: Renter Entryway: A Freestanding Coat Stand Instead of Wall Hooks
pins.desc: Hooks need screws and a wall you are allowed to mark. A coat stand needs a square foot of floor and carries more than a row of hooks ever does, bags included. Put it where the door swings away from it so nothing catches on the way in. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayIdeas #RenterFriendly #CoatStorage
pins.alt: A wooden coat stand holding a jacket and a tote bag beside a two-tier shoe rack in a small entryway, with a patterned runner on the floor.

pins.head: TWO BOTTLES BEAT ONE
pins.sub: A Spare Shaker for the Sink
pins.title: Shaker Bottles: Why a Two-Pack Works Better Than a Single
pins.desc: One shaker means the morning shake waits on last night's washing up. A two-pack lets one dry while the other gets used, and the mixing ball does the work a spoon cannot. Rinse straight after drinking and the smell never starts. Contains affiliate links. #ProteinShake #ShakerBottle #GymEssentials
pins.alt: A clear shaker bottle standing beside an open tub of protein powder with a scoop resting in it on a wooden kitchen counter, with a folded towel behind.

pins.head: A QUARTER INCH RUINS A SET
pins.sub: Bins Fail by a Quarter Inch
pins.title: Kitchen Bin Sizes: Measure the Cabinet Before You Order a Set
pins.desc: A set of bins that is a quarter inch too wide is a set of bins you keep in the garage. Measure the shelf depth, the opening width and the height under the shelf above, then shop to the smallest of the three. Stackable drawers want the height checked twice. Contains affiliate links. #KitchenOrganization #StorageBins #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: An open kitchen cabinet holding clear stackable drawers and jars with a tape measure lying on the shelf edge.
